GOOD QUESTIONS

Curious?
Good.

A few notes before
the first note.

Is MeetPiano ready to use?+

Yes. First Piano Journey is playable now on /learn: twenty-four short jobs (L01–L24) that stay on this device. The mini adventure on this page is a three-mission taste. Accounts, billing, coaching, and Adventure or Family memberships are still in the making.

Do we need a piano to try it?+

No. You can play the mini adventure and First Piano Journey by tapping the on-screen keys or using your computer keyboard. A physical piano or keyboard helps when you want real keys. MIDI hardware is not verified from this site.

Can we connect our keyboard?+

You can try a MIDI keyboard with the preview using “Have a keyboard? Connect it” below the piano. Connect your keyboard to your device first, then allow MIDI access. Compatibility depends on your keyboard, adapter, operating system, and browser. If the browser doesn’t support it, the on-screen keys still work. MIDI is different from Bluetooth audio.

Who is the adventure for?+

Curious younger learners with a parent or grown-up nearby. Older beginners are welcome too. First Piano Journey is ready on /learn; the mini adventure is a short try-it. Age guidance for Adventure and Family memberships will come when those launch.

Does a parent need to know how to play?+

Not at all. A little help getting set up and some encouragement are a great start. There’s already a grown-up view at /learn/?view=grown-up that lists what this device has stored. Cloud family profiles and progress views are still planned.

Will this replace a piano teacher?+

MeetPiano is being designed to support learning and practice. A good teacher brings personal guidance on technique, posture, expression, and more. We want the app to work well alongside that support.
